profile.headline: Experienced Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced software developer and support technician.  Specializing in software development on Windows platforms.

Specialties: Visual Basic .Net (VB.Net), C#, JAVA, SQL, ASP.Net, and database technologies.  SQL Server and Oracle 11g.  Certified Pervasive PSQL Database Technician, versions 9 and 10.  Experienced trainer of groups of 5-30.  Competence with Crystal reports 2008, Crystal Reports 10, and Crystal Reports 2011, and Oracle PL/SQL Developer.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
I’m a software engineering professional with extensive experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise applications and mission-critical Point of Sale (POS) systems. My background includes leading development teams, building scalable APIs, and delivering seamless third-party integrations in complex enterprise environments.

I specialize in .NET, Java, and SQL Server development, with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and maintainable architecture. I also leverage modern AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, accelerate development cycles, enhance code quality, and streamline troubleshooting and documentation workflows.

In the POS space, I have experience developing and supporting integrations with a wide range of retail peripherals and hardware devices, including payment terminals, barcode scanners, receipt printers, cash drawers, customer displays, and other store-level devices critical to retail operations.

Throughout my career, I’ve worked closely with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that improve operational efficiency and support business growth.

My experience spans:

Enterprise software development
API design and third-party integrations
POS systems and transaction processing
POS peripheral and hardware integrations
SQL Server database development and optimization
Team leadership and technical mentorship
System modernization and process improvement
AI-assisted software development workflows and tooling

I enjoy solving complex technical challenges, mentoring developers, and building systems that are scalable, dependable, and adaptable to evolving technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design, develop, and build enterprise Point of Sale software.  Specialize in .Net, Java, and SQL Server development.

positions.title: Senior Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Work as a part of a small IT team to support and enhance the operations of over 60 RV Resorts.  Balance time between working with the Corporate offices, and the Management that works at each of the RV Parks.  

Specialized in creating software tools to help the IT Team, Corporate Offices, and Park Managers.

Developed software to assist with SQL queries.  These Query Tools assisted with Data gathering, report creation, and ETL across 62 databases.

Wrote several Stored Procedures and Functions in Transact-SQL in SQL Server 2012 as part of a reporting data warehouse.  This data compilation was primarily used for Accounting analysis.

positions.title: .Net Developer
positions.description: Work with medium sized development team creating on a web application, back-end processing, and testing for a large entity.  Develop enterprise software using ASP.Net, Entity Framework, PL/SQL, and Oracle 11g for the database.  I was a part of the successful implementation of the New York SSP Project.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed, maintained, and supported proprietary client application on a team of six programmers for over 600 customers coding in VB.Net
Designed and developed report scheduling software which exports crystal reports to various formats
Programmed HTML email body confirmation module, purchased by over 130 customers
Improved troubleshooting efficiency by developing custom tools to find accounting discrepancies
Created/configured new software packages for customers including developing Crystal reports
Assisted first and second tier support technicians with escalated support tickets

positions.title: Senior Software Support Technician
positions.description:
Providing technical support and software configuration help via telephone and the internet. 
Delivery and installation of new products and optional system enhancements. 
Ability to complete projects without supervision, within a pre-defined timetable.
Key Contributions:
 Resolved the most support calls three years in a row, out of a department of 18.

positions.title: Night Auditor
positions.description:
Key Contributions:
Worked on a daily basis with accounting, hotel management, and restaurant management to balance the day's finances.
Promoted to complete accounts payable, worked with ACCPAC inputting AP.
Created a detailed night audit procedures list, working with management and the current auditors to have a comprehensive information packet for all new hires.
